final_face_line: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): oval face, balanced length, wide width; wide heavy chin; almond eyes, medium size, downturned outer corners, average spacing; thick low brows; broad low bridge nose; wide mouth.

casual_plan.scene: In her private rooftop greenhouse in soft early-morning sunlight, watering a small herb pot with a compact ceramic watering jug in her right hand, left hand resting openly on the shelf beside the pot. Warm glass reflections and leafy plants, no other people. Both hands separate and readable.
casual_plan.outfit: Opaque navy satin lingerie-inspired full-cup camisole with secure broad straps, cream lace edging and a short cropped hem, loose high-waisted white linen lounge trousers, tiny orange triangular earrings. Bare shoulders arms and small midriff; fully covered chest and pelvis.
casual_plan.camera: 1024x1536 vertical, head-to-knees portrait in a front three-quarter turn, both whole hands and jug inside frame.
casual_plan.custom: Same adult woman as the approved light reference. Remove armor, large fin ornaments, gills and mantle; only tiny triangular jewelry echoes her species.

casual_plan.scene: At a quiet coastal weather-observation post in cool cloudy midday, adjusting a simple blank hand dial at waist height with one hand while the other rests separately on the post. Small weather mast, distant lighthouse and wind-bent grass, practical peaceful field activity. No text or numbers on instruments.
casual_plan.outfit: Opaque orange sleeveless utility romper with a secured collared neckline, blue belt and tailored mid-thigh shorts in one garment, white walking shoes, a small navy fin pin, bare arms and legs; light cream wind jacket tied around waist.
casual_plan.camera: 1024x1536 vertical, full head-to-toe frontal portrait including both shoes and complete hands, modest 50mm perspective.
casual_plan.custom: Same adult woman as the approved light reference. Remove armor, large fin ornaments, gills and mantle; only tiny triangular jewelry echoes her species.

casual_plan.scene: In an empty glass concert-hall foyer during a night festival, leaning lightly against a waist-high balcony rail and listening to distant music. One hand holds a slim blank folded program at waist level, the other rests openly and separately on the rail. Amber pendant lights and blue harbor lights beyond glass, no people or writing.
casual_plan.outfit: Opaque white one-shoulder draped evening gown with navy waist sash and subtle orange triangular clasp, smooth sculpted folds and long skirt, tiny black fan-shaped stud earrings; bare shoulders and arms, elegant event fashion.
casual_plan.camera: 1024x1536 vertical, waist-up side body angle with face turned toward camera, both complete hands and the blank program fully inside crop.
casual_plan.custom: Same adult woman as the approved light reference. Remove armor, large fin ornaments, gills and mantle; only tiny triangular jewelry echoes her species.
